editorial.blurb: Fuego Logan Square is a vibrant, glam-filled Mexican spot in Logan Square where expertly crafted cocktails and vibrant dishes like al pastor tacos and pollo con mole keep guests coming back.
editorial.insiderTip: Order during weekday lunch for specials, and don't skip the Shredded Chicken Tostada with avocado or the Al Pastor Tacos—both are consistently praised as standouts; the Rose Martini cocktail with edible gold is a signature moment.
